question: What is the minimum finite public action evidence needed to rule out nonresident nonlinear law on already exposed synthetic worlds, and what evidence does NOT justify automatic memory activation?
hypothesis: A read-only finite-domain contradiction auditor will reject all four known out-of-family nonlinear CUE-01 negatives after full 32 public context/action interventions while retaining 12/12 correct observational candidate matches and identical stored native bank checksum, with no falsely accepted knowledge or source authenticity. Report exact accuracy/safety tradeoff for 32,24,16,12,8 action budgets and construct deterministic indistinguishable unknown laws proving no sound universal source-identity verification from any strict subset of 32 actions.

hypothesis_family.public_affordances: 4-bit context x in 0..15 and binary do action in {0,1}, 32 distinct public interventions, consequence exactly bit 0|1
hypothesis_family.source: NKR11 already exposed 12 native causal fixture worlds plus four reused nonresident AND conjunction worlds from CUE01; hidden law and target id are known ONLY to source-only evaluator; NO new protected original source
hypothesis_family.learner: No retraining, no new relationship candidate grammar; immutable existing native bank; source-free auditor reads only bank prediction and public action-result triplets; unknown prediction does not count as support
hypothesis_family.claims: Full-domain equality only means observational equivalence on this 32-action surface, not source identity, independent causal operator invention, or authenticity. Source ID and true relation never enter auditor.

mechanism.public_cues_type: tuple/list [context int 0..15, action int 0|1, outcome int 0|1] with distinct (context,action)
mechanism.candidate: All saved native memory slots with no contrary public consequence and zero unknown outputs on all observed queries; empty/contradictory/unsupported => conservative no verified match
mechanism.status: If 32 distinct complete public responses and unique stored consistent candidate => COMPLETE_DOMAIN_OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_AUTHENTICITY (still accepted_native=false); if no candidate => KNOWN_MEMORIES_FALSIFIED; otherwise only provisional/abstain, NEVER a certified world ID. All calls readonly.
mechanism.dense: all 32 context/action pairs sort by (-popcount(context), -context, -action), maximizing complicated multi-bit interactions generically without knowing source masks
mechanism.hash: sort all 32 pairs by SHA256('CUE02|public-probe|context|action') bytewise ascending
mechanism.action_source: Evaluator calls actual env.intervene(x,a) or the same CUE01 unknown_outcome function; never lets auditor call generator
mechanism.blindness: No oracle, mask, world id, source provenance or private labels in auditor

controls.strong_equal_capacity: Independently implemented exhaustive symbolic filter over all existing 12 native cold-restored NKR11 per-world learner objects, with SAME observed action-results, completedness and ambiguity decision. Expected exact tie, no native-only cognition gain.
controls.weaker_policy_reference: Fixed lex and source-independent SHA-ordered probes; dense is proposed generic nonlinear challenge. Report every budget even if none improves.
controls.negative_witness: For each of 12 known stored laws choose the LAST unqueried public context/action under a fixed 31-probe order, construct an evaluator-only nonresident law identical to known function on other 31 and flipped at the missing action. No algorithm with that 31-probe evidence can distinguish them. The native auditor must refuse authentication before complete 32; source/world identity remains impossible even at 32 if laws coincide.

gates.any_failure: ENGINEERING_DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE; no after-result tweaking of thresholds, source, order or outcomes

qualification.frozen_mechanical_screen: isolated one-shot read-only Ubuntu and Windows
qualification.full_existing_python_regression: Mandatory on exact derived G29 child before claiming engineering acceptance
